segment.text: The Common European Framework of Reference for Languages: Learning, Teaching, Assessment , [ 1 ] abbreviated in English as CEFR , CEF , or CEFRL , is a guideline used to describe achievements of learners of foreign languages across Europe and, increasingly, in other countries.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:2395-2673", "next_segment_id": "lseg-81279946ab48", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-fe2abbdbf71f", "segment_id": "lseg-86149d7a844a", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "The Common European Framework of Reference for Languages: Learning, Teaching, Assessment , [ 1 ] abbreviated in English as CEFR , CEF , or CEFRL , is a guideline used to describe achievements of learners of foreign languages across Europe and, increasingly, in other countries."}}

segment.text: The CEFR is also intended to make it easier for educational institutions and employers to evaluate the language qualifications of candidates for education admission or employment.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:2673-2853", "next_segment_id": "lseg-e3930bf6b0dc", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-86149d7a844a", "segment_id": "lseg-81279946ab48", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "The CEFR is also intended to make it easier for educational institutions and employers to evaluate the language qualifications of candidates for education admission or employment."}}

segment.text: Its main aim is to provide a method of teaching, and assessing that applies to all languages in Europe .

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:2853-2958", "next_segment_id": "lseg-671a82325a0d", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-81279946ab48", "segment_id": "lseg-e3930bf6b0dc", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "Its main aim is to provide a method of teaching, and assessing that applies to all languages in Europe ."}}

segment.text: The CEFR was established by the Council of Europe between 1986 and 1989 as part of the "Language Learning for European Citizenship" project.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:2958-3099", "next_segment_id": "lseg-ee93bcaf227c", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-e3930bf6b0dc", "segment_id": "lseg-671a82325a0d", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "The CEFR was established by the Council of Europe between 1986 and 1989 as part of the \"Language Learning for European Citizenship\" project."}}

segment.text: In November 2001, a European Union Council Resolution recommended using the CEFR to set up systems of validation of language ability.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:3099-3233", "next_segment_id": "lseg-cb9cc5178ecd", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-671a82325a0d", "segment_id": "lseg-ee93bcaf227c", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "In November 2001, a European Union Council Resolution recommended using the CEFR to set up systems of validation of language ability."}}

segment.text: The six reference levels (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2) are becoming widely accepted as the European standard for grading an individual's language proficiency .

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:3233-3388", "next_segment_id": "lseg-e92f950db72f", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-ee93bcaf227c", "segment_id": "lseg-cb9cc5178ecd", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "The six reference levels (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2) are becoming widely accepted as the European standard for grading an individual's language proficiency ."}}

segment.text: As of 2024, "localized" versions of the CEFR exist in Japan , Vietnam , Thailand , Malaysia , and Mexico , with the Malaysian government writing that "CEFR is a suitable and credible benchmark for English standards in Malaysia.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:3388-3616", "next_segment_id": "lseg-49d93ab303a8", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-cb9cc5178ecd", "segment_id": "lseg-e92f950db72f", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "As of 2024, \"localized\" versions of the CEFR exist in Japan , Vietnam , Thailand , Malaysia , and Mexico , with the Malaysian government writing that \"CEFR is a suitable and credible benchmark for English standards in Malaysia."}}

segment.text: " [ 2 ] Development [ edit ] An intergovernmental symposium in 1991 titled "Transparency and Coherence in Language Learning in Europe: Objectives, Evaluation, Certification" held by the Swiss Federal Authorities in the Swiss municipality of Rüschlikon found the need for a common European framework for languages to improve the recognition of language qualifications and help teachers co-operate.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:3616-4012", "next_segment_id": "lseg-b275491dd914", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-e92f950db72f", "segment_id": "lseg-49d93ab303a8", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "\" [ 2 ] Development [ edit ] An intergovernmental symposium in 1991 titled \"Transparency and Coherence in Language Learning in Europe: Objectives, Evaluation, Certification\" held by the Swiss Federal Authorities in the Swiss municipality of Rüschlikon found the need for a common European framework for languages to improve the recognition of language qualifications and help teachers co-operate."}}

segment.text: A project followed to develop language-level classifications for certification to be recognised across Europe.

segment.text: — The Guardian , 15 April 2004 Theoretical background [ edit ] The CEFR divides general competences in knowledge , skills , and existential competence with particular communicative competences in linguistic competence , sociolinguistic competence and pragmatic competence .

segment.text: [ 6 ] Language activities [ edit ] The CEFR distinguishes four kinds of language activities: reception (listening and reading), production (spoken and written), interaction (spoken and written) and mediation (translating and interpreting).

segment.text: [ 6 ] Domains [ edit ] General and particular communicative competencies are developed by producing or receiving texts in various contexts under various conditions and constraints.

segment.text: [ 88 ] Non-Western areas and languages [ edit ] The CEFR, initially developed to ease human mobility and economic growth within the highly multilingual European Union, has since influenced and been borrowed by various other areas.

segment.text: [ 92 ] Around 2005, the Osaka University of Foreign Studies developed a CEFR-inspired project for its 25 foreign languages, with a transparent and common evaluation approach.

segment.text: While major languages had long had well-defined tools for the Japanese public, able to guide teachers in teaching and performing assessments in a methodic way, this project pushed the adoption of similar practices to smaller languages, as requested by students.

segment.text: [ 98 ] Companion Volume [ edit ] CEFR-Companion Volume (2020) The CEFR Companion Volume (CEFR-CV) is an extension and update of the original CEFR.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:29272-29419", "next_segment_id": "lseg-c8f8aa1035df", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-e127f7528835", "segment_id": "lseg-366b43d0bc02", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "[ 98 ] Companion Volume [ edit ] CEFR-Companion Volume (2020) The CEFR Companion Volume (CEFR-CV) is an extension and update of the original CEFR."}}

segment.text: It provides new and extended illustrative descriptors covering a wider range of communicative activities, including online interaction, mediation , plurilingual / pluricultural competence, and sign language competencies.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:29419-29640", "next_segment_id": "lseg-8ebc49cbcceb", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-366b43d0bc02", "segment_id": "lseg-c8f8aa1035df", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "It provides new and extended illustrative descriptors covering a wider range of communicative activities, including online interaction, mediation , plurilingual / pluricultural competence, and sign language competencies."}}

segment.text: It also introduces various communicative language activities and strategies.

idempotency_key: language.segment.created:{"segment": {"confidence": 1.0, "end_time": null, "locator": "chars:29640-29717", "next_segment_id": "lseg-7aa05791e617", "page_locator": "", "previous_segment_id": "lseg-c8f8aa1035df", "segment_id": "lseg-8ebc49cbcceb", "source_id": "lsource-308f5f0c8ea2", "start_time": null, "text": "It also introduces various communicative language activities and strategies."}}

segment.text: Additionally, existing descriptors have been refined to more accurately reflect the nuances of language use and to address any identified gaps since the original CEFR publication.

segment.text: "Mediation" [ edit ] In the 2001 edition, "mediation" meant translating, interpreting, summarizing, reporting, etc.
